description: This file defines the ContentFragment class, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying and interacting with image content in a gallery app. It handles UI setup, drag-and-drop, click and long-press actions, content updates, and sharing images.

classes.name: ContentFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages display and interaction with images in a gallery application, including drag-and-drop, selection, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, sets up drag-and-drop, click, and long-press event listeners.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Performs additional setup after the activity's onCreate method, including restoring state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item selections, such as navigation.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current UI state and content positions for configuration changes.

methods.name: setSystemUiVisible
methods.description: Toggles visibility of system UI elements and action bar.

methods.name: processDragStarted
methods.description: Checks if drag event data has the expected MIME type.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes a drop event, updating content based on what was dragged.

methods.name: updateContentAndRecycleBitmap
methods.description: Updates the displayed image content and recycles previous bitmap resources.

methods.name: shareCurrentPhoto
methods.description: Compresses and shares the current image asynchronously.
